name: Awesome System Design Resources
summary: Curated list of free system design resources and interview problems, from core concepts to distributed systems papers.
description: A curated repository of free resources for learning system design and preparing for interviews. Concepts are organised into sections — core concepts, networking, API, database, caching, asynchronous communication, distributed systems and microservices, architectural patterns and tradeoffs — followed by system design interview problems grouped easy, medium and hard, plus courses, newsletters, books, YouTube channels, engineering articles and distributed systems papers.
contains: free resources to learn system design concepts and prepare for interviews

distributed systems, microservices, architectural patterns, tradeoffs
system design interview problems grouped easy, medium, hard
courses, newsletters, books and YouTube channels
must-read distributed systems papers (Paxos, MapReduce, GFS, Dynamo, Kafka, Spanner)
